summary: Tunica County, MS Forestry Commission site: a 100 ft Aermotor tower with a 7x7 cab and steel stair treads, NHLR-registered June 2022 as US 1602; build date and history unknown.

facts.design: 100ft tall tower with a 7' x 7' cab manufactured by Aermotor; steel stair treads
facts.status_note: Register describes the tower in the present tense; no visit date or later report found

events.note: Registered June 18, 2022 as US 1602, MS 7; nominated by Jason Johns

evidence.supports: described as a Mississippi Forestry Commission location
evidence.quote: This is a Mississippi Forestry Commission located In Tunica County, Mississippi.

evidence.supports: Mississippi Forestry Commission listed under Cooperators
design: 100ft tall tower with 7 by 7 foot cab by Aermotor
evidence.quote: It is a 100ft tall tower with a 7' x 7' cab manufactured by Aermotor.

evidence.supports: steel stair treads rather than the typical wooden treads
evidence.quote: One interesting detail is the steel stair treads instead of the typical wooden treads.

corrections.why: The register lists the Mississippi Forestry Commission as cooperator and describes the tower as an MFC location; the agency field is blank.

notes_for_editor: Single source: the NHLR entry, with no visit date, so the standing status rests on its present-tense description. Two searches returned only other Mississippi towers (Woodland, Paret, Moore), which were not used for this record. No build date, builder, staffing, fire history, ownership or access information was found. The agency correction is a cooperator fact, not an administrator fact, so the editor may prefer to keep the field blank.
